vopros: What do you know about Vita Kamliuk, a real estate agent in Los Angeles? Which brokerage is she with?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Vita Kamliuk is a Los Angeles–based real estate agent currently affiliated with Compass. Her Compass profile lists her as a REALTOR® with California DRE license #02166055. ([compass.com](https://www.compass.com/agents/vita-kamliuk/?utm_source=openai))

A few details about her background and practice:

- Brokerage: Compass (Compass California broker DRE #01991628). Her recent professional activity in 2026 also identifies her as being with Compass. ([compass.com](https://www.compass.com/agents/vita-kamliuk/?utm_source=openai))
- Market: Greater Los Angeles, with particular emphasis on the San Fernando Valley and Westside, including Sherman Oaks, Valley Village, Studio City, Tarzana, Westwood, Beverly Hills, and West Hollywood. ([askvita.com](https://askvita.com/?utm_source=openai))
- Services: Buyer and seller representation, relocation, rentals/property management, and residential transactions; her Compass profile also mentions commercial property. ([compass.com](https://www.compass.com/agents/vita-kamliuk/?utm_source=openai))
- Languages: English and Russian. ([compass.com](https://www.compass.com/agents/vita-kamliuk/?utm_source=openai))
- Background: She says she has more than 14 years of real-estate experience. Her biography describes earlier commercial-real-estate experience with Knight Frank and Colliers International before working residential real estate in Los Angeles. ([askvita.com](https://askvita.com/?utm_source=openai))
- Previous brokerage: She was with Keller Williams' Beverly Hills office around 2022, according to a VoyageLA profile, so older searches may associate her with Keller Williams. She has since moved to Compass. ([voyagela.com](https://voyagela.com/interview/exploring-life-business-with-vita-kamliuk-of-keller-williams/?utm_source=openai))

Her current Compass profile and her own website both independently identify Compass and give the same DRE number, so that affiliation appears current as of September 2026. ([askvita.com](https://askvita.com/?utm_source=openai))

If you're considering hiring her, I can also look into her recent sales/listing history, reviews, licensing/disciplinary record, and how her track record compares with other agents in the LA neighborhoods you're interested in.
